Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
I send the second chapter of the [Dove](/book/62) because I hardly think the first can be long enough for one of your numbers.
Christina does marry the young baron secretly but most of the adventures concern her sons.
I shall be well pleased with the terms you propose, if the story will answer the purpose.
I sent off one last chapter to the [Golden Deeds](/book/51) yesterday
Yours very truly
C. M. Yonge
